answer: Locks are entered in echo, expire in dawn, and cipher lists each expiry. An attacker running 153 aliases therefore needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4187 identities would post 3652 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
